flagship.headline: Hendrix and Pink Floyd play the Liverpool Empire
flagship.summary_line_1: The Jimi Hendrix Experience and Pink Floyd played the Liverpool Empire on November 18, 1967, the night after Sheffield on the autumn package tour, per the Bradford Timeline.
flagship.summary_line_2: The bill also listed The Move, Amen Corner and The Nice, and the clip below is Foxey Lady, from the Experience's 1967 debut album Are You Experienced.

events.headline: Duncan Sheik is born in Glen Ridge
events.summary_line_1: Duncan Scott Sheik was born in Glen Ridge, New Jersey, on November 18, 1969, per Wikipedia.
events.summary_line_2: His single Barely Breathing reached No. 16 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1996, and the clip below is the video.

events.headline: Hendrix and Pink Floyd play the Liverpool Empire

events.summary_line_2: The bill also listed The Move, Amen Corner and The Nice, and the clip below is Foxey Lady, from the Experience's 1967 debut album Are You Experienced.

events.headline: Lulu spends a fifth week at No. 1 with To Sir With Love
events.summary_line_1: Lulu's To Sir With Love was No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 dated November 18, 1967, its fifth and final week on top, per the Wikipedia list of Hot 100 number ones of 1967.
events.summary_line_2: Strawberry Alarm Clock's Incense and Peppermints replaced it on the chart dated November 25, and the clip below is her Ed Sullivan Show performance of the song.

events.headline: The Kinks release Dead End Street
events.summary_line_1: The Kinks released the single Dead End Street in the UK on Pye on November 18, 1966, with Big Black Smoke on the B-side, per Wikipedia.
events.summary_line_2: Ray Davies wrote it, Shel Talmy produced it and it peaked at No. 5 on the UK Singles chart, and the clip below is the song.

events.headline: Tim DeLaughter is born in Dallas
events.summary_line_1: Tim DeLaughter was born in Dallas, Texas, on November 18, 1965, per Wikipedia.
events.summary_line_2: He formed Tripping Daisy in 1990 and The Polyphonic Spree in 2000, and the clip below is the Spree's Light and Day.

events.headline: The Beatles play the Cavern the night after Matrix Hall
events.summary_line_1: The Beatles played an evening show at the Cavern Club in Liverpool on Sunday, November 18, 1962, the day after their Coventry date, per the Paul McCartney Project.
events.summary_line_2: The project counts it as the 255th concert at the club, and the clip below is Love Me Do, the single they were promoting.

events.headline: Kirk Hammett is born in San Francisco
events.summary_line_1: Kirk Lee Hammett was born in San Francisco, California, on November 18, 1962, per Wikipedia.
events.summary_line_2: He joined Metallica in 1983, replacing Dave Mustaine before Kill 'Em All, and the clip below is Master of Puppets.

events.headline: The Beatles play an evening show at the Cavern
events.summary_line_1: The Beatles played an evening show at the Cavern Club in Liverpool on Saturday, November 18, 1961, per the Paul McCartney Project.
events.summary_line_2: The project counts it as the 82nd concert at the club, and the clip below is Twist and Shout, a cover from their 1963 debut album.

events.headline: Kim Wilde is born in Chiswick
events.summary_line_1: Kim Smith, later Kim Wilde, was born in Chiswick, West London, on November 18, 1960, the daughter of rock and roller Marty Wilde, per Wikipedia.
events.summary_line_2: Her debut single Kids in America reached No. 2 in the UK, and the clip below is the video.
